description: Answers: Which public companies are filing about undersea cables, cable landings, offshore wind for data centres or ocean cooling? The reply opens with a one-line answer and its date. Subsea Data Watch. SEC filings · undersea cables, cable landings, offshore wind for data centres, ocean cooling · the filer’s own sentence. Sourced from SEC EDGAR; every row links to its filing. Free, CC BY 4.0.
